Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Counter-proposal 1.4404 bar – price basis 2027
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your Angebot. A 12-month term leaves our second year uncovered, so we propose a 24-month commitment on the full 23,700 kg a year, which gives you the volume security you are looking for. On cost: the AS-14404 rise of 5.9 % on a 45 % share is about 2.7 % on your price, and we hold a competing quote for the same term, so we cannot move to €6.10.

Our packages (DAP, 14 days lead time, no index clause):
A) €5.50, 60 days net, 24 months
B) €5.44, 30 days net, 24 months

If one of these works, we can confirm quickly. If you need a different structure, please send your calculation behind the price.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We welcome your proposal for a 24-month commitment, which provides valuable volume security for both sides.
For a contract of this duration, we must include the AS-14404 index clause to sustainably manage raw material volatility.
With this index applied, we can reduce our base price to €5.60 at 30 days net, and we kindly request proof of the competing quote you referenced.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.60 per unit.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Angebot 24 months - AS-14404 clause
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for the revised Angebot and the 24-month price of €5.60. Regarding proof of the competing quote: I can confirm we hold a written quote for the same 24-month term at 30 days net and DAP. We cannot share the document.

On the clause: the AS-14404 rise is 5.9 %. On a 45 % share that is about 2.7 % of your price, and a 0 % deadband clause works in both directions while adding risk on our side. Even your 5 % deadband version would cost us roughly 0.9 % of spend in expected move plus risk. We would rather fix the price for the full 24 months, which gives you stable volume of 23,700 kg a year.

Our packages (DAP, 14 days lead time, no index clause):
A) €5.45, 60 days net, 24 months
B) €5.40, 30 days net, 24 months

If you can confirm one of these, we can close quickly.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: Our packages for 24 months
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your reply. The competing quote is in writing for the same 24-month term at 30 days net, DAP. We cannot share the document. On the index data: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months. On a 45 % share that is about 2.7 % of the price, and a 0 % deadband leaves us with all of the risk.

We can move toward your structure. Both packages are DAP, 14 days lead time, 23,700 kg a year, 24 months:
A) €5.50, 60 days net, AS-14404 clause with a 5 % deadband
B) €5.42, 30 days net, no index clause

A gives you the clause you asked for, with the first 5 % of any move staying with you. B gives you a fixed price. If you can confirm one of these, we can close quickly.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke
